metadata.title: Fix HTML new line tags in server team column display
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
Closes #2923 ## Summary Fix literal `
` text appearing in the server listing team column by removing forced `
` replacement and using CSS for natural text wrapping. ## Changes **File:** `mcpgateway/templates/servers_partial.html` **Before:** ```html {% if server.team %} {{ server.team|e|replace(' ', '
')|safe }} {% else %} N/A {% endif %} ``` **After:** ```html {% if server.team %} {{ server.team }} {% else %} N/A {% endif %} ```

commits.message:
fix: remove unsafe br replacement in server team column display Remove the fragile |e|replace|safe Jinja2 filter chain that converted spaces to
tags. With autoescape=True globally enabled, the |safe filter bypassed escaping protections unnecessarily. Replace with the standard team column pattern used across all other partial templates (tools, resources, prompts, gateways): plain variable output with whitespace-nowrap and consistent styling. Closes #2923 Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
